sn41.4:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū macchikasaṇḍe viharanti ambāṭakavane.
sn41.4:1.2: atha kho citto gahapati yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho citto gahapati there bhikkhū etadavoca
sn41.4:1.3: adhivāsentu me bhante therā svātanāya gokule bhattanti.
sn41.4:1.5: atha kho citto gahapati therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā there bhikkhū abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
sn41.4:1.6: atha kho therā bhikkhū tassā rattiyā accayena pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena cittassa gahapatino gokulaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdiṃsu.
sn41.4:2.1: atha kho citto gahapati there bhikkhū paṇītena sappipāyāsena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
sn41.4:2.2: atha kho therā bhikkhū bhuttāvino onītapattapāṇino uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu.
sn41.4:2.3: cittopi kho gahapati sesakaṃ visajjethāti vatvā there bhikkhū piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi.
sn41.4:2.4: tena kho pana samayena uṇhaṃ hoti kuṭṭhitaṃ.
sn41.4:2.5: te ca therā bhikkhū paveliyamānena maññe kāyena gacchanti yathā taṃ bhojanaṃ bhuttāvino.
sn41.4:3.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahako tasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe sabbanavo hoti.
sn41.4:3.2: atha kho āyasmā mahako āyasmantaṃ theraṃ etadavoca
sn41.4:3.3: sādhu khvassa bhante therassa sītako ca vāto vāyeyya abbhasaṃpilāpo ca assa devo ca ekamekaṃ phusayeyyāti.
sn41.4:4.1: sādhu khvassa āvuso mahaka yaṃ sītako ca vāto vāyeyya abbhasaṃpilāpo ca assa devo ca ekamekaṃ phusayeyyāti.
sn41.4:4.2: atha kho āyasmā mahako tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhari yathāyaṃ sītako ca vāto vāyi abbhasaṃpilāpo ca assa devo ca ekamekaṃ phusi.
sn41.4:4.4: yo kho imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe sabbanavo bhikkhu tassāyaṃ evarūpo iddhānubhāvoti.
sn41.4:4.5: atha kho āyasmā mahako ārāmaṃ sampāpuṇitvā āyasmantaṃ theraṃ etadavoca
sn41.4:4.10: atha kho therā bhikkhū yathāvihāraṃ agamaṃsu
sn41.4:5.1: atha kho citto gahapati yenāyasmā mahako tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahakaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho citto gahapati āyasmantaṃ mahakaṃ etadavoca
sn41.4:5.2: sādhu me bhante ayyo mahako uttarimanussadhammaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassetūti.
sn41.4:5.3: tenahi tvaṃ gahapati āḷinde uttarāsaṅgaṃ paññapetvā tiṇakalāpaṃ okāsehīti.
sn41.4:5.4: evambhanteti kho citto gahapati āyasmato mahakassa paṭissutvā āḷinde uttarāsaṅgaṃ paññapetvā tiṇakalāpaṃ okāsesi.
sn41.4:5.5: atha kho āyasmā mahako vihāraṃ pavisitvā sucighaṭikaṃ datvā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhari yathā tāḷacchiggaḷena ca aggaḷantarikāya ca acci nikkhamitvā tiṇāni jhāpesi na uttarāsaṅgaṃ jhāpesi.
sn41.4:5.6: atha kho citto gahapati uttarāsaṅgaṃ papphoṭetvā saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
sn41.4:5.7: atha kho āyasmā mahako vihārā nikkhamitvā cittaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca
sn41.4:6.8: atha kho āyasmā mahako senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaramādāya macchikasaṇḍamhā pakkāmi
sn41.4:6.9: yaṃ macchikasaṇḍamhā pakkāmi tathā pakkantova ahosi
